one_improvement.candidate: Add a pre-freeze executable boundary contract: capture a sanitized tuple of source SHA, process PID/UID, socket dev/inode, Unix peer PID/UID and selected-leaf digest; immediately before private config write, take a fresh tuple and require exact equality or fail closed.
one_improvement.failure_behavior: Stop before credential-bearing file write, record only failing category and hashes, no node names or secret bytes.
one_improvement.invalidation: Any tuple mismatch, missing field, source change, or runner source change invalidates proposed release; no old candidate receipt reuse.
one_improvement.key: source SHA + process PID/UID + socket dev/inode + connected Unix peer PID/UID + selected-leaf digest + exact runner source SHA
one_improvement.mechanism: Moves current-leaf freshness from an assumption into an executable dependency at the write boundary, preventing stale node selection from being copied.
one_improvement.pilot_result: Existing v2a runner lacks late identity read calls before write; six synthetic tuple fixtures pass, rejecting changed selection, source, socket, peer and missing readback. No actual controller access.
one_improvement.promotion_gate: A fresh runner generation must expose late snapshot function immediately before write, pass unchanged and single-field mutation fixtures without creating a private file, pass independent peer review for this seam and all other blocking findings, then receive separate root release. Do not use EVO46 pilot as release.
one_improvement.risk: AST call-order screening is shallow and can miss semantic alternatives; must pair with mutation fixtures at the exact write seam and peer source review.
one_improvement.scope: Only G279 private proxy v2a syntax runner contract. Does not solve recursive reference scanning, no-network syntax proof, child cleanup, v2b listener, v2c SSH or APK startup.
